blocks.text: President Lee Jae Myung on Tuesday reaffirmed Seoul’s ambitions to open up the Arctic Northern Sea Route, pledging strict compliance with international norms and sanctions along the way. Lee underscored the drive while attending a ceremony welcoming the return of the PanStar Acro, which embarked on a trial voyage along the Arctic shipping route on Aug. 22 and returned Sunday. The vessel completed South Korea’s first commercial round-trip voyage to Europe via the Arctic.
